scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p modpacks-migrator-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/modpacks_migrator_wasm.wasm --target web --out-dir public/pkg
